name: Wicked People
overview: Scripture reveals that wickedness is a fundamental corruption of God's creation, evident from the earliest chapters where man’s disobedience brings death and sorrow (Genesis 2:17; 3:16). The Lord’s judgment on a corrupt and violent generation underscores the seriousness of sin, as He declares His intention to destroy mankind due to their pervasive wickedness (Genesis 6:7, 12). Despite God's patience, human flesh remains prone to sin, and His Spirit will not strive with man indefinitely (Genesis 6:3). These verses emphasize the gravity of sin and the certainty of divine justice against wickedness.
